description: Event/temporal/causal fabula (typed before/causes edges over situation-model events + a precedence flood for story-time) and inference/entailment/QA (the rule engine over the model: forward-chain to fixpoint, entailment = did B materialise, QA = bind the WH-slot). Implication rules chain fell+fragile -> on_floor -> broken -> worthless.

attrs.name: fabula
attrs.description: The ordering structure OVER the situation-model events: two edge-types between event nodes — before/after (from tense/aspect + connectives then/after) and causes/enables (from because/so + role-continuity) — with story-time resolved as a precedence flood (a topological flood over the event-DAG, the sibling of the navigation distance-field). It is the INVERSE of the narrative faculty: narrative linearises fabula->sjuzhet to tell it, fabula reads the arc back.

attrs.name: inference_qa
attrs.description: Not a new faculty — the RULE ENGINE standing over the situation model. Forward-chaining = run_rules to fixpoint across Implication rules; ENTAILMENT of B = run to fixpoint then check whether B materialised (or its negation -> contradiction); QA = the bind mechanism run inward (a question is a model node with one unbound WH-role; answering = match-and-bind). Entailment, multi-hop, and QA collapse into one operation: match-and-bind to fixpoint.

attrs.name: fabula_recovers_chronology
attrs.head: event reasoning
attrs.body: test: unscramble a flashback-ordered text into true chronology and recover trip->fall from "he fell because he tripped"

attrs.name: inference_is_multi_hop
attrs.head: event reasoning
attrs.body: a good inference chains: fell + fragile -> on_floor -> broken -> worthless (3 hops) materialised by running the implication rules to fixpoint

attrs.name: qa_is_match_and_bind
attrs.head: event reasoning
attrs.body: answering a question is binding its unbound WH-slot against the fixpoint model; entailment is the yes/no case of the same bind
